messages:
June (Design): quick post-playtest note: the structured-output/tool-calling preview in Playground looks cleaner but keyboard users are getting stuck. Tab lands on the Close X and you can't reach tool shortcuts or argument inputs.
Arif (DevEx): can you add repro steps? I want to confirm whether this is the modal focus-lock or the new compact side panel.
June (Design): repro: open function def -> click Preview -> press Tab. focus jumps to Close then cycles. expectation: Tab should enter the panel body and arrow keys should traverse tool items.
Maya (Frontend): yep that's the focus-lock default. straightforward fix: set initialFocus to the panel body or tool-list and implement roving tabindex for tool items so Arrow keys move selection.
Leo (A11y): agree. recommend role=listbox on the tool list, role=option on each tool, aria-activedescendant for the active item, sr-only keyboard hint attached via aria-describedby, and ensure Esc closes + returns focus to invoker. Also announce dialog open for screen readers.
Ruth (PM): product caveat: keep preview lightweight. avoid auto-focusing inputs on mobile (keyboard pop). on narrow widths prefer bottom-sheet pattern and require explicit tap to focus.
Maya (Frontend): plan: desktop = side panel with initialFocus on .tool-list container; mobile = bottom-sheet without autofocus. add icon hint in header with short visible text and full instruction as sr-only.
Arif (DevEx): rollout steps: small PR to change initialFocus selector, add aria attrs & sr-only hint, Storybook showing keyboard flows, QA keyboard pass, canary behind feature flag.
SmokeTester-Bot: e2e tasks created: PLG-KEY-901 (panel focus order) and PLG-KEY-902 (roving list navigation).
June (Design): copy nit: header currently says "Preview invocation" 1 maybe swap to "Invocation preview" and add a tiny inline hint like "Tab or 91	3 keys"; the full instruction remains sr-only.
Leo (A11y): icon hint is fine if keyboardable and linked via aria-describedby. screen readers should read the full instruction in the sr-only node; tooltip should be supplemental for sighted keyboard users.
Maya (Frontend): will add a small icon-button with aria-controls/aria-expanded to reveal the helper, plus .sr-only text: "Use Tab to enter tools; Arrow keys to move; Enter to invoke; Esc to close." Will also add unit + storybook tests.
Arif (DevEx): small unrelated follow-up: run-history rows truncate function names mid-word. can we use ellipsis at word boundary and show full name on hover/focus?
Maya (Frontend): yes, switching to text-overflow: ellipsis + title attribute and compact detail popover on focus.
Ruth (PM): prioritize keyboard + screen-reader fixes first; run-history truncation can be a follow-up if timeline is tight.
June (Design): perfect. please ping me for micro-copy polish before merge. :sparkles:
